headline.purpose: The source-screen promise and the selected cart total.

title.purpose: Deck name, section headings and seller names.

numeric.purpose: Prices, counts and ETAs; always tabular.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions on buttons, chips and the order rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that starts or applies the work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--orange-dark, #c94724); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--orange-dark, #c94724); color: #fff; font: 660 12.5px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b9401f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions: filters, collection, stop, run again.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbc2b2); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-2, #efe8da); color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 660 12.5px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #e5dccb); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: A board or option that is included in the run.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--orange, #e4572e); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--orange-soft, #f8ddd2); color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 640 10.5px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-count { color: var(--orange-dark, #c94724); font-size: 9.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Plan Lane
components.description: One of three landed-cost plans; a row, never a card.
components.css: .ds-plan-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 21px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 2px 8px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 3px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cbc2b2); background: #fff7ef; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plan-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 17px; height: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--orange, #e4572e); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--orange, #e4572e); color: #141815; font-size: 11px; } .ds-plan-main { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-plan-main strong { color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 720 12.5px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-plan-main small { color: var(--muted, #62685f); font-size: 10.5px; } .ds-plan-total { display: flex; min-width: 76px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 760 14px/1.1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plan-total small { color: var(--muted, #62685f); font: 400 10px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-plan-lane:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Order Rail
components.description: The signature: seller stops on an ink strip, height by card count.
components.html: Order rail2 stops · €18.20
components.css: .ds-rail { padding: 9px 11px 8px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #1e2420); color: var(--surface, #f8f3e9); } .ds-rail-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: rgba(248,243,233,.6); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail-track { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; padding-top: 6px; } .ds-rail-stop { display: flex; min-width: 40px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgba(248,243,233,.65); cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-line { display: block; width: 1px; height: 20px; background: rgba(248,243,233,.36); } .ds-rail-stop.active .ds-rail-line { width: 2px; background: var(--orange, #e4572e); } .ds-rail-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 1px; background: rgba(248,243,233,.55); } .ds-rail-stop.active .ds-rail-dot { background: var(--orange, #e4572e); } .ds-rail-num, .ds-rail-name { color: rgba(248,243,233,.65); font-size: 8px; } .ds-rail-stop.active .ds-rail-num, .ds-rail-stop.active .ds-rail-name { color: var(--surface, #f8f3e9); }

components.name: Seller Stack
components.description: A seller's parcel as a hairline row with an expandable manifest.
components.css: .ds-seller-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 2px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #cbc2b2); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seller-index { color: var(--line-strong, #a79b87); font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seller-main { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-seller-main strong { color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 700 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-seller-main small, .ds-seller-total small { color: var(--muted, #62685f); font-size: 9.5px; } .ds-seller-total { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; color: var(--ink, #1e2420); font: 740 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seller-row:hover { background: rgba(239,232,218,.55); } .ds-seller-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Apply Dialog
components.description: The one lifted surface; confirmation before touching the real cart.
components.html:
Apply to your real cart?

This changes the live Cardmarket cart. It does not check out or pay.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 460px; max-width: calc(100vw - 28px); padding: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #a79b87); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #f8f3e9); color: var(--ink, #1e2420); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(30,36,32,.3); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 770; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--muted, #62685f); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog label { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #cbc2b2); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 680; } .ds-dialog input { accent-color: var(--orange, #e4572e); } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 7px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-dialog-cancel, .ds-dialog-apply { padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 9px; font: 660 12.5px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbc2b2); background: var(--surface-2, #efe8da); color: var(--ink, #1e2420); } .ds-dialog-apply { border: 1px solid var(--orange-dark, #c94724); background: var(--orange-dark, #c94724); color: #fff; } .ds-dialog-apply:focus-visible, .ds-dialog-cancel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f4e79); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: DeckCart looks like the table where a card seller sorts a deck into seller piles: warm putty paper, dark ink labels, a bright safety-orange marker, and a parcel manifest rail. It is a working surface, not a storefront. The deck arrives as a receipt; the options are a tray of labelled chips; the result is a set of seller stacks and a rail that makes the cost of every extra order visible.
keyCharacteristics: Warm putty paper against an ink shell.
Safety-orange selection and primary action, never decoration.
Dense vertical stacking, hairline rules, no nested card grids.
One signature move: the order rail.
Every number is tabular and every estimate says it is an estimate.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange marks a choice or an action. If it is not clickable, selected, or the brand mark, it is not orange.

rules.name: The Red Means Broken Rule
rules.body: Red and amber only carry missing cards, failed requests or warnings. They never decorate.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: No display face, no serif, no mono costume. Hierarchy comes from scale, weight and spacing.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: The side panel is a stack of trays, not a dashboard grid. Wide screens get breathing room, not more columns of cards.

rules.name: The Flat Tray Rule
rules.body: A tray gets a border or a shadow, never both. Hover is a tone change, not a lift.

dos: Do keep orange for the selected plan, active rail stop and primary action.
Do use tabular numerals for every price, count and ETA.
Do show the collection source and the owned count before subtracting.
Do keep the order rail and seller stacks in sync.
Do label estimates as estimates; the cart is the authority.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient text, glass or decorative blur.
Don't turn the seller stacks into nested cards or a dashboard grid.
Don't use a display font or monospace as a costume for prices.
Don't hide a missing card, a failed shipping route or a security check.
Don't checkout, pay or claim the final postage is known before the cart is.
